_notes: Starter patterns. Copy this file to config.local.json (gitignored) and edit. Any label added here becomes a Prometheus label; keep them to low-cardinality dimensions such as env / service / team / domain.

patterns._note: Generic error counter — pick this pattern first for every service you onboard.
patterns.name: error

patterns._note: Lambda hitting its wall-clock timeout. High-signal because it usually means an upstream stopped responding.
patterns.name: timeout

patterns._note: Domain-specific: payment DLX / dead-letter queue arrivals. Convert your business's real failure token here.
patterns.name: payment_dlx

patterns._note: Distributed lock contention (Redis / DB) — often precedes user-visible slowdowns.
patterns.name: lock_contention
patterns.filter_pattern: "lock acquire failed" OR "RedLock" OR "could not obtain lock"

patterns._note: Auth / OAuth denials from partner integrations. Not always an incident, but a spike is diagnostic.
patterns.name: auth_denied
